newsitem.title: USA: US domestic auto sales off 1.2 pct Jan 21-31 - CNW.
newsitem.headline: US domestic auto sales off 1.2 pct Jan 21-31 - CNW.

text.p: U.S. domestic auto sales fell 1.2 percent in the 10-day period January 21-31 compared with the same period a year ago, according to a CNW Marketing/Research report released on Monday.
Domestic car sales dropped to 212,225 from 217,681, CNW said. Domestic truck rose 0.3 percent to 175,406, the report said.
Import car sales rose 0.6 percent to 56,186 and import truck sales advanced 0.7 percent to 11,781, it said.
About 952,466 vehicles were sold in the United Sates this year to date, down from 987,479 for the same period in 1996, CNW said.
